original.statement: A new optional field spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID was added to the Issuer v1 schema.

decision.reason: The validators confirm from the v1.16.0 and v1.17.0 CRD artifacts [ev-84061d76ea1b][ev-60054fcf0986] that spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID is new in the cert-manager.io/v1 Issuer schema. The change only adds a field, so the consequence is "none" for every environment. Because nothing fails, the exposure condition only decides who gets an informational notice, and "uses Issuer v1" is a fair scope for an Issuer schema addition. P3's narrower managedIdentity-set condition is not better supported by the evidence, and no canonical exposure exists for an added crd-field, so confidence is low.
